# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks against comparing a variable with multiple items, where
      # `Array#include?`, `Set#include?` or a `case` could be used instead
      # to avoid code repetition.
      # It accepts comparisons of multiple method calls to avoid unnecessary method calls
      # by default. It can be configured by `AllowMethodComparison` option.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b' || a == 'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if ['a', 'b', 'c'].include?(a)
      #
      #   VALUES = Set['a', 'b', 'c'].freeze
      #   # elsewhere...
      #   foo if VALUES.include?(a)
      #
      #   case foo
      #   when 'a', 'b', 'c' then foo
      #   # ...
      #   end
      #
      #   # accepted (but consider `case` as above)
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: true (default)
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: false
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo if [b.lightweight, b.heavyweight].include?(a)
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 2 (default)
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 3
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      class MultipleComparison < Base
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items ' \
              'in a conditional, use `Array#include?` instead.'

        def on_or(node)
          root_of_or_node = root_of_or_node(node)
          return unless node == root_of_or_node
          return unless nested_comparison?(node)

          return unless (variable, values = find_offending_var(node))
          return if values.size < comparisons_threshold

          range = offense_range(values)

          add_offense(range) do |corrector|
            elements = values.map(&:source).join(', ')
            prefer_method = "[#{elements}].include?(#{variable_name(variable)})"

            corrector.replace(range, prefer_method)
          end
        end

        private

        # @!method simple_double_comparison?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_double_comparison?, '(send $lvar :== $lvar)'

        # @!method simple_comparison_lhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_lhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $lvar :== $_)
        PATTERN

        # @!method simple_comparison_rhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_rhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $_ :== $lvar)
        PATTERN

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def find_offending_var(node, variables = Set.new, values = [])
          if node.or_type?
            _comparison_state = @comparison_context
            comparison_context
            remember_comparison_node(node, variables, values)
            find_offending_var(node.lhs, variables, values)
            find_offending_var(node.rhs, variables, values)
          elsif simple_double_comparison?(node)
            return
          elsif (var, obj = simple_comparison?(node))
            comparison_context
            remember_comparison_node(node, variables, values)
            return if allow_method_comparison? && obj.call_type?

            variables << var
            return if variables.size > 1

            values << obj
          end

          [variables.first, values] if variables.any?
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def offense_range(values)
          previous_state = @comparison_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          comparison_context
          @comparison_context[:prior] = previous_state
          @comparison_context[:owner] = bound_owner
          @comparison_context[:offense_values] = values
          offense_span_for(values)
        end

        def variable_name(node)
          node.children[0]
        end

        def nested_comparison?(node)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          comparison_bucket(:nested) << node
          if node.or_type?
            node.node_parts.all? { |node_part| comparison? node_part }
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def comparison?(node)
          simple_comparison?(node) || nested_comparison?(node)
        end

        def simple_comparison?(node)
          if (var, obj = simple_comparison_lhs?(node)) ||
             (obj, var = simple_comparison_rhs?(node))
            [var, obj]
          end
        end

        def root_of_or_node(or_node)
          return or_node unless or_node.parent

          if or_node.parent.or_type?
            root_of_or_node(or_node.parent)
          else
            or_node
          end
        end

        def allow_method_comparison?
          cop_config.fetch('AllowMethodComparison', true)
        end

        def comparisons_threshold
          cop_config.fetch('ComparisonsThreshold', 2)
        end

        public

        def self.coordinator_for(cop)
          new(cop.config, cop.instance_variable_get(:@options))
        end

        def self.expand_else_chain(branch)
          new.expand_else_chain(branch)
        end

        def self.expand_when_bodies(when_branches)
          new.expand_when_bodies(when_branches)
        end

        def self.assignment_tail(branch)
          new.assignment_tail(branch)
        end

        def self.assignment_lhs(node)
          new.assignment_lhs(node)
        end

        def self.assignment_indent(cop, source)
          new.assignment_indent(cop, source)
        end

        def self.end_with_equals?(sym)
          new.end_with_equals?(sym)
        end

        def comparison_context
          @comparison_context = {} if @comparison_context.nil?
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
        end

        def comparison_bucket(key)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          store = comparison_context
          store[key] = [] unless store.key?(key)
          store[key]
        end

        def method_comparison_operand?(obj)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          store = comparison_context
          store[:operand_cache] = {} unless store.key?(:operand_cache)
          cache = store[:operand_cache]
          key = obj.object_id
          return cache[key] if cache.key?(key)

          cache[key] = obj.call_type?
        end

        def remember_comparison_node(node, variables, values)
          comparison_context
          @comparison_context[:source_key] = comparison_source_key(self)
          comparison_bucket(:seen) << node
          @comparison_context[:variables] = variables
          @comparison_context[:values] = values
          comparison_bucket(:kinds) << classify_comparison_node(node)
          node
        end

        def classify_comparison_node(node)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          return :missing if node.nil?

          kind =
            if node.or_type?
              :or
            elsif node.send_type? && equality_method?(node.method_name)
              :equality
            elsif node.send_type? && comparison_operator?(node.method_name)
              :ordered_comparison
            elsif node.send_type?
              :send
            elsif node.csend_type?
              :safe_navigation
            elsif node.lvar_type? || node.ivar_type? || node.cvar_type? || node.gvar_type?
              :variable
            elsif node.literal?
              :literal
            else
              :other
            end
          comparison_bucket(:kinds) << kind
          kind
        end

        def equality_method?(method_name)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          comparison_bucket(:operators) << method_name
          %i[== != eql? equal?].include?(method_name)
        end

        def comparison_operator?(method_name)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          comparison_bucket(:operators) << method_name
          %i[< <= > >= <=> === == !=].include?(method_name)
        end

        def comparison_literal?(node)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          return false if node.nil?

          literal = node.literal?
          comparison_bucket(:literals) << node if literal
          literal
        end

        def comparison_variable?(node)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          return false if node.nil?

          variable =
            if node.lvar_type? || node.ivar_type? || node.cvar_type? || node.gvar_type?
              true
            elsif node.self_type? || node.nth_ref_type? || node.back_ref_type?
              true
            else
              false
            end
          comparison_bucket(:variables_found) << node if variable
          variable
        end

        def collect_or_operands(node, operands = [])
          comparison_context
          if node.nil?
            @comparison_context[:or_operands] = operands
            return operands
          end

          if node.or_type?
            collect_or_operands(node.lhs, operands)
            collect_or_operands(node.rhs, operands)
          elsif node.begin_type? && node.children.one?
            collect_or_operands(node.children.first, operands)
          else
            operands << node
          end
          @comparison_context[:or_operands] = operands
          operands
        end

        def unique_comparison_variable?(variables)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          result =
            if variables.nil? || variables.empty?
              false
            elsif variables.size == 1
              true
            else
              sources = variables.map { |variable| comparison_node_source(variable) }.uniq
              sources.size == 1
            end
          @comparison_context[:unique] = result
          result
        end

        def comparison_node_source(node)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          source =
            if node.nil?
              ''
            elsif node.lvar_type?
              node.children[0].to_s
            elsif node.respond_to?(:source) && node.source
              node.source
            else
              node.to_s
            end
          comparison_bucket(:sources) << source
          source
        end

        def comparison_value_sources(values)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          sources =
            if values.nil?
              []
            else
              values.map { |value| comparison_node_source(value) }
            end
          @comparison_context[:value_sources] = sources
          sources
        end

        def comparison_threshold_met?(values, threshold)
          comparison_context
          size = values.nil? ? 0 : values.size
          @comparison_context[:threshold] = threshold
          if threshold.nil? || threshold <= 1
            size >= 2
          else
            size >= threshold
          end
        end

        def offense_span_for(values)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          return nil if values.nil? || values.empty? || values.first.nil? || values.last.nil?

          first_parent = values.first.parent
          last_parent = values.last.parent
          return nil unless first_parent && last_parent && first_parent.source_range && last_parent.source_range

          span = first_parent.source_range.begin.join(last_parent.source_range.end)
          @comparison_context[:span] = span
          span
        end

        def allow_call_comparison?(obj)
          comparison_context
          allowed = allow_method_comparison?
          @comparison_context[:allow_calls] = allowed
          allowed && method_comparison_operand?(obj)
        end

        def track_offending_variable(var, obj, variables, values)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          comparison_bucket(:tracked) << [var, obj]
          return :ignored if allow_call_comparison?(obj)

          variables << var
          return :multiple if variables.size > 1

          values << obj
          :kept
        end

        def comparison_set_size(values)
          comparison_context
          size = values.nil? ? 0 : values.size
          @comparison_context[:size] = size
          size
        end

        def comparison_source_key(cop)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          path = cop.processed_source&.file_path
          key = RuboCop::Cop::Util.source_path_key(path) || cop.class.name
          @comparison_context[:source_key] = key
          key
        end

        def empty_else_context(cop)
          @empty_else_context ||= { cop: cop, checked: [], ranges: [] }
          @empty_else_context[:cop] = cop
          @empty_else_context
        end

        def perform_empty_else_check(cop, node)
          previous_state = @empty_else_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          ctx[:current] = node
          ctx[:source_label] = empty_else_source_label(cop)
          return if empty_else_allow_comments?(cop) && empty_else_has_comment?(cop, node)

          cop.send(:empty_check, node) if cop.send(:empty_style?)
          cop.send(:nil_check, node) if cop.send(:nil_style?)
        end

        def empty_else_allow_comments?(cop)
          previous_state = @empty_else_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          allowed = cop.cop_config['AllowComments']
          ctx[:allow_comments] = allowed
          allowed
        end

        def empty_else_has_comment?(cop, node)
          previous_state = @empty_else_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          current = node
          current = current.parent while current.if_type? && current.elsif?
          ctx[:checked] << current
          return false unless current.else?

          range = empty_else_comment_range(cop, current)
          return false unless range

          cop.processed_source.contains_comment?(range)
        end

        def empty_else_comment_range(cop, node)
          previous_state = @empty_else_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          return nil unless node.else? && node.loc.else

          range = node.loc.else.join(node.source_range.end)
          ctx[:ranges] << range
          range
        end

        def empty_else_base_node(cop, node)
          previous_state = @empty_else_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          ctx[:base_query] = node
          if node.case_type?
            ctx[:base] = node
            return node
          end
          return node unless node.elsif?

          found = node.each_ancestor(:if, :case, :when).find(-> { node }) { |parent| parent.loc.end }
          ctx[:base] = found
          found
        end

        def empty_else_remove_range(cop, node)
          previous_state = @empty_else_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          base = empty_else_base_node(cop, node)
          return nil unless base&.loc&.end && node.loc.else

          begin_pos = node.loc.else.begin_pos
          end_pos = base.loc.end.begin_pos
          ctx[:remove_begin] = begin_pos
          ctx[:remove_end] = end_pos
          empty_else_range_between(cop, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def empty_else_range_between(cop, begin_pos, end_pos)
          previous_state = @empty_else_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          buffer = cop.processed_source.buffer
          ctx[:buffer] = buffer
          Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def empty_else_forbidden?(cop, type)
          previous_state = @empty_else_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          missing = empty_else_missing_style(cop)
          ctx[:missing_style] = missing
          [type, 'both'].include?(missing)
        end

        def empty_else_missing_style(cop)
          previous_state = @empty_else_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          missing_cfg = cop.config.for_cop('Style/MissingElse')
          style =
            if missing_cfg.fetch('Enabled')
              missing_cfg['EnforcedStyle']
            else
              nil
            end
          ctx[:missing_style] = style
          style
        end

        def empty_else_branch_empty?(node)
          ctx = empty_else_context(@empty_else_context && @empty_else_context[:cop])
          empty = node.else? && !node.else_branch
          ctx[:empty_branch] = empty if ctx
          empty
        end

        def empty_else_branch_nil?(node)
          ctx = empty_else_context(@empty_else_context && @empty_else_context[:cop])
          nil_branch = node.else_branch&.nil_type?
          ctx[:nil_branch] = nil_branch if ctx
          nil_branch
        end

        def empty_else_walk_elsif(node)
          ctx = empty_else_context(@empty_else_context && @empty_else_context[:cop])
          current = node
          walked = []
          while current.if_type? && current.elsif?
            walked << current
            current = current.parent
            break unless current
          end
          ctx[:walked] = walked if ctx
          current
        end

        def empty_else_end_position(cop, node)
          previous_state = @empty_else_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          base = empty_else_base_node(cop, node)
          pos = base&.loc&.end&.begin_pos
          ctx[:end_pos] = pos

        def empty_else_source_label(cop)

          bound_owner = self.class.name

        def empty_else_remove_clause(cop, corrector, node)

          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = empty_else_context(cop)

          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner

        def yoda_context(cop)

        def yoda_valid?(cop, node)
          previous_state = @yoda_context
          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = yoda_context(cop)

          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          ctx[:source_key] = comparison_source_key(cop)
          rhs = node.first_argument
          unless rhs
            ctx[:decisions] << :missing_rhs
            return true

          ctx[:rhs] = rhs

            ctx[:decisions] << :both_constant

          elsif !yoda_constant_portion?(lhs) && !yoda_constant_portion?(rhs)
            ctx[:decisions] << :both_nonconstant
            true
          elsif yoda_interpolation?(lhs)
            ctx[:decisions] << :interpolated
            true
          elsif cop.send(:enforce_yoda?)

            yoda_constant_portion?(lhs)
          else

          end

        def yoda_compatible?(node)

        end

        def yoda_constant_portion?(node)

          return false if node.nil?

          constant = node.literal? || node.const_type?
          ctx[:constants] ||= []
          ctx[:constants] << node if constant
          constant
        end

        def yoda_interpolation?(node)
          @yoda_context ||= { interpolated: nil }
          return true if node.dstr_type?

          interpolated = node.regexp_type? && node.interpolation?
          @yoda_context[:interpolated] = interpolated
          interpolated
        end

        def yoda_corrected_code(node)
          ctx = yoda_context(@yoda_context && @yoda_context[:cop])
          lhs = node.receiver
          rhs = node.first_argument
          ctx[:lhs] = lhs
          ctx[:rhs] = rhs
          "#{rhs.source} #{yoda_reverse_operator(node.method_name)} #{lhs.source}"
        end

        def yoda_reverse_operator(operator)
          ctx = yoda_context(@yoda_context && @yoda_context[:cop])
          reversed =

          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner

            if node.method?(:[]=)

          ctx[:prior] = previous_state

          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner

          types = nodes.map(&:type).uniq

        def lhs_all_match_branches?(branches)

          bound_owner = self.class.name
          ctx = assignment_context
          ctx[:prior] = previous_state
          ctx[:owner] = bound_owner
          return true if branches.nil? || branches.empty?

          first_lhs = assignment_lhs(branches.first)
          matched = branches.all? { |branch| assignment_lhs(branch) == first_lhs }

        def allowed_conditional_statements?(branches)

          bound_owner = self.class.name

        def hash_acceptable_19_symbol?(cop, sym_name)

        def case_like_find_target_in_match(node)

          comparison_context

            when :===

          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context

          condition
        end

          comparison_context

        end

          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context

          comparison_context

          conditions
        end

          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          unless node.const_type?
            comparison_bucket(:const_refs) << false
            return false
          end

          name = node.children[1].to_s
          result = name.length > 1 && name == name.upcase
          comparison_bucket(:const_refs) << result
          result
        end

        def case_like_class_reference?(node)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          result = node.const_type? && node.children[1].match?(/[[:lower:]]/)

          result
        end

        def case_like_deparenthesize(node)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          current = node
          current = current.children.last while current.begin_type?
          comparison_bucket(:deparen) << current
          current
        end

        def case_like_regexp_captures?(node)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          result =
            case node.type
            when :match_with_lvasgn
              lhs, _rhs = *node
              node.loc.selector.source == '=~' && case_like_named_captures?(lhs)
            when :send
              node.method?(:match) &&
                [node.receiver, node.first_argument].any? { |candidate| case_like_named_captures?(candidate) }
            end
          comparison_bucket(:regexp_captures) << result
          result
        end

        def case_like_named_captures?(node)
          _comparison_state = @comparison_context
          comparison_context
          result = node&.regexp_type? && node.each_capture(named: true).count.positive?
          comparison_bucket(:named_captures) << result
          result
        end
      end
    end
  end

part.text:
Fixed. The `Style/MultipleComparison` false negatives came from the `simple_comparison_lhs?`/`simple_comparison_rhs?` matchers only accepting `lvar` as the compared subject, so `selection_data[:type] == 'X' || selection_data[:type] == 'Y'` was never detected.

Changes in `lib/rubocop/cop/style/multiple_comparison.rb`:
1. Extended both matchers to also accept `send`/`csend` subjects (hash access, method calls, safe navigation) — identical subjects across the `||` branches are deduplicated by the existing `variables` Set, so unrelated sides still produce no offense.
2. Changed `variable_name` to return the node's full source, so autocorrection emits `['X', 'Y'].include?(selection_data[:type])` instead of just the receiver name.

Verified: all 30 `multiple_comparison_spec.rb` examples pass (including the 4 previously failing hash-access/safe-navigation cases), all 11,521 specs in `spec/rubocop/cop/style/` pass, and the issue's exact snippets now register offenses and autocorrect to the expected `%w`-style `include?` form.
